decisions.decision: Ms. Noble will advertise the part-time Meal Site Coordinator position outside of the town, after no suitable in-house applicants.
decisions.quote: ms. noble will be advertising outside of the town for this position.

decisions.decision: Ms. Noble will order the kitchen equipment (steam table, industrial refrigerator/freezer, sandwich/salad bar unit, pizza warmer, hot dog roller) from Kittredge Equipment Company, with the wall oven ordered through Home Depot.
decisions.quote: ms. noble has contacted kittredge equipment company for quotes and will be ordering the following:

budget_items.topic: Capital Planning kitchen equipment approval (Eagle House)
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Capital Planning approved $10K for replacing the oven, refrigerator, and steam table in the large Eagle House kitchen.
budget_items.quote: capitol planning had approved $10k for the replacement of the oven, refrigerator, and steam table in the large

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The items to be ordered from Kittredge Equipment Company will amount to $8355.00.

budget_items.topic: Wall oven purchase through Home Depot
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The small wall oven must be ordered through Home Depot at an approximate cost.
budget_items.quote: due to the small size of the wall oven it will need to be ordered through home depot at a cost of approximately $1200.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The remainder of the $10K may possibly be used to replace tables at the senior center.
budget_items.quote: the remainder of the money could possibly be used to replace tables at the senior center.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: COA utility bills are paid on time, but a transfer into the Water Line will be needed to cover future expenses; no amount was given.
budget_items.quote: although there will need to be a transfer into the water line to cover future expenses.

budget_items.topic: Supporters of the Eagle House contribution
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Supporters of the Eagle House contributed $8100.00 last year to the Eagle House Senior Center for items not covered in the COA budget.
budget_items.quote: the supporters of the eagle house had contributed $8100.00 last year to the eagle house senior center for items not covered in the coa budget.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Jim Hays requested a COA Finance Sub-Committee meeting to discuss the FY14 budget; no figures were given.
budget_items.quote: jim hays requested that a coa finance sub-committee meeting be scheduled to discuss the fy14 budget.

budget_items.topic: Recreation area behind Eagle House funding
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Completion of the recreation area behind the Eagle House will need funding; no amount was given.
budget_items.quote: pete lincoln stated that funding will need to be provided for completion of the recreation area.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A COA revolving fund holds money collected for the Senior Center on Lunenburg Relief Day.
budget_items.quote: there is $4900. in a coa revolving fund which was collected for the senior center on lunenburg relief day.
